anti_overlap: Defers to fd-staged-dispatch-correctness on dispatch ordering; defers to fd-budget-integration on budget logic
decision_lens: No code path can result in a safety-critical agent running below its declared min_model
focus: Ensure safety floor clamping is never violated by any code path in the tier adjustment pipeline
name: fd-safety-floor-invariant
persona: Safety systems engineer who treats min_model floors as hard invariants
review_areas: Order of operations: does _routing_apply_safety_floor run AFTER all adjustments (downgrade + budget pressure)?
Namespace stripping — does the floor lookup handle both 'fd-safety' and 'interflux:review:fd-safety'?
Budget pressure override — can 'high' pressure force an exempt agent below sonnet?
New _routing_downgrade function — does it respect model tier ordering (opus→sonnet→haiku, never opus→haiku)?
Agent-roles.yaml coverage — are all agents that need floors declared? What about project-specific agents?

severity_examples.condition: Budget pressure applied after safety floor instead of before
severity_examples.scenario: fd-correctness routed to haiku because budget_pressure='high' overrides safety floor

severity_examples.condition: Floor lookup only checks hardcoded agent list
severity_examples.scenario: Project agent with min_model declared in agent-roles.yaml not recognized by expansion tier adjustment

success_hints: Safety floor is the LAST operation in the pipeline — nothing can override it. Exempt agents skip the entire adjustment.
task_context: agent-roles.yaml declares min_model per role. lib-routing.sh has _routing_apply_safety_floor(). The brainstorm proposes routing_adjust_expansion_tier() as a new function.
